entities.name: Suren Tovmasyan
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Suren Hakobi Tovmasyan was a Soviet Armenian politician and diplomat who served as the First Secretary of the Communist Party of Armenia from 1953 to 1960, and later as Soviet ambassador to North Vietnam and to Libya.
